messages:
maria: quick sync — we need to finalize rerank endpoint semantics before tomorrow's canary. two main asks: scoring format and candidate limits.
jun: high level — product expects scores usable for sorting and delta-thresholding. do we want 0-1 normalized probs, arbitrary floats (logits), or rank-only?
alex: prefer normalized floats in [0,1] plus optional raw_score field. makes downstream thresholding easy. also keeps telemetry interpretable.
tyler: +1 on normalized, but careful about calibration. some models output skewed probs; we should document that scores are model-dependent.
maria: good point — doc + console note. we also need to decide max candidates per call. current internal clients sometimes send 200. we can't route 200->dedicated for every tiny request.
jun: operational constraints: default max_candidates=50, hard cap=500 per request for Dedicated. for Hosted we should limit default to 100 and enforce per-tenant quota.
tyler: can we rely on batching to absorb heavy tails? if someone sends 500, batching helps but latency SLO will break. suggest a request-level throttle with clear 4xx error message.
alex: error payload idea: return 413-like JSON with recommended reduced_count and a link to console quota page. e.g.
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{ "error":"candidate_limit_exceeded", "allowed":100, "suggestion":"use paging or reduce candidates","help":"https://console.redwood.ai/rerank/docs#limits" }
```
maria: love that. routing question — pick reranker model by tenant: premium -> rerank-large, default -> rerank-slim. but fallback when capacity is constrained?
jun: yes — policy: route to tenant-preferred model, but if latency or capacity exceeded, fallback to cheaper model in same family. add header in response indicating model_used and fallback_reason.
alty: infra-bot: deploy plan: add routing flag "allow_fallback": true/false per tenant. default true for non-enterprise. will emit telemetry: model_chosen, fallback_reason, candidate_count, latency_ms.
maria: console UX — show per-tenant breakdown of fallback rates, avg score distribution, and top failed requests. product wants a gauge for "score drift" over time.
alex: telemetry detail — include score_histogram (binned), but watch size. maybe histogram summary (counts per bucket) as small map. also include model_version tag.
tyler: API schema proposal (minimal):
```
POST /v1/rerank
body: {"query":"...","candidates":[{"id":"...","text":"..."}],"max_candidates":50,"allow_fallback":true}
response: {"model":"rerank-slim-v2","scores":[0.81,0.12,...],"raw_scores":[12.3,1.8,...]?}
```
maria: question for eng-sre — do we need per-tenant rate-limits separate for rerank? some customers will spam candidate lists.
jun: yes split by token-like units: count candidates as units toward quota. recommended meter = candidate_count * requests. keep metering simple.
alty: infra-bot: putting a canary in prod with new schema tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. will add a feature-flagged header X-RERANK-SCHEMA: beta for clients.
maria: rollout UX: we should surface a deprecation notice when clients don't opt into the new header after 30 days. add console banner and email to owners.
alex: last API debate: include raw_scores optional field? pros: useful for debugging and evals. cons: increases payload and might leak model internals. proposal: optional raw_scores only for tenants with "dev_debug" permission and for Hosted set an enterprise opt-in.
tyler: +1 optional gated raw_scores. also add config to redact raw_scores in logs unless permitted.
maria: ok action items: (1) finalize API schema PR (alex), (2) telemetry spec (jun + tyler), (3) console widgets (maria + product), (4) docs + deprecation plan (jun). I'll open tickets. thanks. :thumbsup:
